title: Parity agreement forces a degree cutoff
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $\varepsilon_0,\varepsilon,k\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon_0$ and $\varepsilon<4\varepsilon_0^2$. Suppose that, under the uniform distribution on $\{-1,1\}^n$, $f$ agrees with the parity function on all $n$ coordinates with probability at least $\tfrac12+\varepsilon_0$. If the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over subsets of size greater than $k$ is at most $\varepsilon$, then $n\le k$.
